Record Class SqlJsonViewMetadata

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.model.schema.sql.metadata.SqlJsonViewMetadata
Record Components:
name - The view name
status - The view status, can be null
tables - The tables of the view, a table used more than once is listed for each use
fields - The JSON fields of the view mapped to table columns
links - The links of the sub view tables to their parent tables
@Internal public record SqlJsonViewMetadata(String name, @Nullable String status, List<SqlJsonViewMetadata.Table> tables, List<SqlJsonViewMetadata.Field> fields, List<SqlJsonViewMetadata.Link> links) extends Record
Oracle JSON relational duality view metadata extracted from the database dictionary views ALL_JSON_DUALITY_VIEWS, ALL_JSON_DUALITY_VIEW_TABS, ALL_JSON_DUALITY_VIEW_TAB_COLS and ALL_JSON_DUALITY_VIEW_LINKS.
Since:
5.3.0
